test_name: authenticated discover nav uses compass SVG
angular_behavior: When authenticated, the Discover entry in the top bar is an anchor wrapping tg-svg with svg-icon="icon-compass" (vector compass).
react_behavior: Discover uses nav.tg-navbar with a text link (◎) instead of nav.navbar + tg-svg compass.

angular_behavior: Forgot-password view includes auth-container, explanatory copy, and a form with input name="username" for reset.
react_behavior: Route renders PlaceholderPage only; auth-container and recovery form are absent.

test_name: authenticated navbar home logo includes SVG mark
angular_behavior: Authenticated navbar home link uses nav.navbar a.logo with an embedded SVG mark.
react_behavior: Authenticated nav uses nav.tg-navbar a.tg-logo text without the Angular navbar SVG logo.

test_name: login form uses placeholder copy on username/password fields
angular_behavior: Login uses input[name="username"] / input[name="password"] with placeholder strings for username and password (no separate labels in the DOM).
react_behavior: React uses id-based inputs with labels; name="username" is absent and placeholders do not match Angular.

test_name: login page shows Taiga auth chrome and inline forgot-password link
angular_behavior: Login shows .auth-container with logo-svg, h1.logo Taiga, h2.tagline, and inline a.forgot-pass with text "Forgot it?".
react_behavior: React login omits that auth-container chrome and inline forgot link pattern (different structure and copy).

test_name: project backlog renders scrum backlog shell
angular_behavior: Backlog route renders section.backlog with full scrum backlog implementation (no migration placeholder).
react_behavior: Backlog URL shows only PlaceholderPage; section.backlog is absent.

test_name: project root loads timeline shell with project-data
angular_behavior: After opening project root/timeline, .project-data project chrome is visible and placeholder is absent.
react_behavior: Timeline route shows PlaceholderPage; .project-data is absent.

angular_behavior: Authenticated projects listing shows .project-list-wrapper and MY_PROJECTS heading.

test_name: register route serves registration form when public registration is enabled
angular_behavior: When publicRegisterEnabled, /register exposes form.register-form with username field.
react_behavior: Register route shows PlaceholderPage; register form is absent.

test_name: wiki home deep link loads wiki editor shell
angular_behavior: After wiki redirect to wiki/home, section.main.wiki is present and migration placeholder is absent.
react_behavior: After same redirect, only PlaceholderPage is shown; section.main.wiki is absent.
